title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array `nums`, find the contiguous subarray (containing at least one number) with the largest sum and return its sum.

hints.text: Track the best subarray sum ending at each position.
At position i, either extend the previous subarray or start fresh at nums[i].
Kadane's recurrence: bestEndingHere = max(nums[i], bestEndingHere + nums[i]); answer is the max over all positions.
